'''Mike Parker''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Tucson tournament]] on 12 November 2000 with Tatooine aliens deck, according to Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1453">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-tucson-az-11-12-00d1453/ tucson-az-11-12-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-tucson-az-11-12-00d1453/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
